id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

keyspace.description:
Cassandra key space name in which the table lies.
egs: engiegridops_filesystem

memtableOffHeapGbs.description: memtable Off heap memory in GB

liveGbs.description: Live Space used by the table in GB

totalGbs.description: Total space used by the table in GB

keyCount.description:
Estimated number of Keys in table
Storing this as string as number of keys can increase maximum value of Integer.

tombstoneCount.description:
Average tombstone count encountered during recently sampled queries.
The timer is by default using exponentially decaying reservoir sampling.
Roughly accounts for last five minutes of data, exponentially weighting towards newer data.

liveCellCount.description:
Average liveCell count encountered during recently sampled queries.
The timer is by default using exponentially decaying reservoir sampling.
Roughly accounts for last five minutes of data, exponentially weighting towards newer data.

fragmentationPct.description: Fragmentation of the table as a percentage number in the range [0, 100]

title:
This type is used to store cassandra table stats info every day.
the information stored will consume data returned from node tool cfstats api.
name: CassandraTableStats
